structured_output.what_is_happening: LOAN ("Loan Meme", pitched as a meme lend/borrow protocol, X @loanmeme, site loanmeme.io) is a 16-minute-old token trading mainly in a PumpSwap pool. The pool was set up by hand: RugCheck shows 100% of its LP unlocked, and the token launched on Meteora's DBC curve, whose pools are now empty. It has about $2.5M volume on a ~$180-200k market cap and +200-250% in the first hour. One wallet (FhVo...) holds 80% of supply with no AMM or locker label. Another token with the same name, LOAN (paGVWB...), launched about 18 minutes before this pool. It did $2.29M of volume in the last hour and now shows $0 liquidity, which looks like a pulled pool. This looks like a relaunch of the same brand, and there are also many dead 'Loan Meme' copies on pump.fun from earlier today.

narrative.description: A meme coin that claims to be a lending protocol for memes ('the meme that runs a protocol'). The website is marketing only: no contract address, no docs, no team.
narrative.why_spreading: The attention seems to come from the brand/X account and from on-chain trading bots. I found no outside news or wider discussion. The many copycat pump.fun launches show some ticker interest, but they are all dead.

token_connection.why_this_token: GMGN links this token to the @loanmeme X account and loanmeme.io. Right now it is the only LOAN with live liquidity.
token_connection.competing_tokens: paGVWB... LOAN had $2.29M volume in the last hour, launched about 18 minutes before this pair, and now shows 0 liquidity, which looks like a pulled pool. There are also 8+ dead 'Loan Meme' pump.fun clones at about $3k market cap.

authenticity.evidence: 910 unique buyers but only 48 unique sellers, who made 1,174 sells between them. That points to bot or market-maker churn. GMGN flags 20 bundler wallets. No paid DexScreener promotion. No smart-money or KOL wallets. The dev's X account has launched 143 tokens.
authenticity.uncertainty: X was inaccessible (HTTP 402), so I could not see real engagement.

structural_risks: One unlabeled wallet holds 80% of supply against about $47k of liquidity
100% of the PumpSwap LP is unlocked (RugCheck danger flag)
Same-name predecessor token appears to have had its liquidity pulled about 18 minutes earlier
Dev's X account has launched 143 tokens
20 bundler wallets; sells are concentrated in 48 wallets

structured_output.counterargument: The 80% wallet might be a Meteora or protocol vault, or a lending-reserve contract that GMGN leaves out of its top-10 figure (GMGN puts top10_holder_rate at 5.9%, which contradicts RugCheck). If so, the float is spread across more than 900 buyers. Price is holding and rising (+247% in the last hour, still up over the last 5 minutes) with heavy volume. A branded 'protocol meme' with a live X account and website could keep running to $500k+.
unknowns: Whether paGVWB... was rugged or migrated by the same team
Real engagement and follower count on @loanmeme

source_coverage.notes: Contract-address search returned nothing. The X profile returned HTTP 402. Current pair data came from the DexScreener API. The site has marketing copy only. Time was short, so Telegram and Discord were not searched.

structured_output.thesis: A serial-launch pattern (dev X account with 143 launches, a same-name predecessor whose liquidity went to zero minutes ago, 80% of supply in one wallet, unlocked LP, sells concentrated in a few wallets) points to a likely extraction setup, despite strong-looking volume. Upside needs the price to double to about $400k while that 80% wallet does not dump. Low runner odds, high rug odds.
